positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead full-stack effort to support new payment infrastructure in internal CX management platform, enabling critical CX operations (i.e., fee visibility, partial refunds) while maintaining backward-compatibility to legacy payment infrastructure.
- Eliminated single-item-transaction restriction in checkout logic, which enabled bundling functionality on web platform, ensured correct sales tax calculation for multi-item orders, and better positioned the adoption of new payment infrastructure.
- Implemented Mercari’s first public HTTP API for inventory management to acquire professional sellers with large supplies of high-quality inventory.
- Lead final push to migrate remaining 50+ GitHub repositories from CircleCI to internal CI platform which allowed business to terminate contract with expensive and often unreliable third-party CI platform.
- Migrated coupon applicability logic from PHP monolith to Go microservice, reconciling conflicting applicability logic across backend infrastructure and and allowing possibility of additional type of incentives.
- Lead initiative to 27% of daily outgoing data points to third-party CRM by de-duping messages from GCP PubSub topic.
- Developed back-up mechanism to send SMS and email notifications (via Twilio) in response to frequent outages of third-party customer engagement (CRM) platform.
- Serve as owner of coupon-related Go microservices, auxiliary code in backend-for-frontends, and associated cloud infrastructure.
- Follow Google API Improvement Proposals (AIPs) to design gRPC API endpoints and implement interfaces using Protocol Buffers (Protobuf ).
- Write and maintain manifests to manage Kubernetes objects.
- Lead interns through onboarding process, assign tasks, and facilitate their task execution.
- Present demos to fellow backend engineers and provide tech talks to non-technical audiences.
- Develop and present product ideation to business stakeholders.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Application Development · Go (Programming Language) · Software Development · Technical Communication

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
CS5004/5: Object-Oriented Design with Java
- Lead a cohort of 9 graduate students.
- Conducted further instruction during weekly recitation sessions to ensure students master technical concepts.
- Guided students in effective debug and testing strategies using various IDEs (Eclipse, IntelliJ, VSCode) and JUnit.
- Delivered constructive and actionable feedback to students on assignments.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
East Side Access: CM007 Grand Central Terminal Caverns
- Lead the closeout of $46 million of mechanical equipment.
- Correspond with MTACC on status of closeout.
- Orchestrate the submissions of all O&M and warranty packages as part of asset management.
- Design and schedule O&M training courses for LIRR and MTA personnel.
- Maintain Contract Redlines & As-Builts.
- Manage WDF Inc. & Five Star Electric to ensure mechanical assets are functional.
- Report directly to the MEP Manager.


East Side Access: CS179 System Facilities Package #1
- Reconciled over $1 million through an internal audit of all T&M.
- Implemented new protocol for bookkeeping and billing of T&M work.
- Processed change orders to subcontractors.
- Obtained & negotiated Scopes of Work from subcontractors.
- Coordinated & supervised scheduled work for Vernon Boulevard & Roosevelt Island facilities.
- Managed electrical subcontractor to ensure work is completed in accordance with schedule.
- Maintained subcontractor 6-Week Look Ahead Schedule and send updates to Owner.
- Assigned cost codes to daily foreman timesheets.
- Submitted equipment & material requisitions to purchasing agent.
- Report directly to the Project Manager.

positions.title: Project Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Clark Civil Estimating Department:

- Determined scopes of work for trades using specifications and drawings.
- Used Bluebeam to perform quantity takeoffs to support scopes of work.
- Coordinated with other estimators to ensure all scope items picked up.
- Communicated with subcontractors during pre-bid stage.

Maryland 355 Crossing Project:

- Tracked and submitted RFI’s and submittals to Owner.
- Managed subrequisitions of subcontractors.
- Maintained on-site documents and drawings.

positions.title: Project Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Supervised and worked alongside chipping, excavating, and formwork crews during day-to-day operations.
- Implemented daily quality assurance program into operations.
- Recorded weekly Operations and Owners’ meeting minutes.
- Performed rebar and excavation quantity takeoffs.
- Issued purchase orders for material procurement.
- Measured work quantity for production tracking.
- Facilitated daily safety meetings with field crew.
